---
title: "Website Example"
---

This public-safe website example demonstrates the initial HTML styling for a
Quarto website.

The visual direction is based on the public Háskóli Íslands design standard,
HÖNNUNARSTAÐALL HÍ: <https://honnun.hi.is/>. This repository is not presented as
an official Háskóli Íslands product.

## Components

::: {.hi-lead}
Lead text can introduce a page while keeping the layout simple and reusable.
:::

::: {.hi-highlight}
Highlighted content can point readers to a public event, course description, or
general institutional information.
:::
